properties.article_text_excerpt: A Ukrainian soldier adjusts a Starlink satellite dish at a front-line position. Photograph: Reuters View image in fullscreen A Ukrainian soldier adjusts a Starlink satellite dish at a front-line position. Photograph: Reuters Russia-Ukraine war at a glance Ukraine Explainer Ukraine war briefing: Finland urges Elon Musk to expand Kyiv’s Starlink coverage over Russia Ukraine believes that turning on Starlink over Russian territory would help it target missile launchers. properties.article_text_excerpt: in Brussels The EU is deadlocked over a plan to remove two Russian billionaires, Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman, from its sanctions list as part of a bitterly disputed deal to keep broader restrictions in place on nearly 3,000 people and companies accused of enabling Vladimir Putin’s war on Ukraine. Ambassadors from the EU’s 27 member states failed to reach agreement at a meeting early on Tuesday – their third session in around 24 hours on the topic. The senior diplomats will reconvene later today just hours ahead of a legal deadline. Without an agreement sanctions on nearly 3,000 people and entities accused of supporting the war on Ukraine will lapse at the end of Tuesday 22 September. The list includes Vladimir Putin, foreign minister Sergei Lavrov, Duma deputies, Russia’s major banks, energy companies and military industrial complex.
